verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own product list names 'Whiteboards' as a first-party feature, so the capability exists. The evidence is only a bare one-word label, with no description of shared canvases, real-time multi-user editing, or visual tooling. The Figma embed integration is a third-party tool and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented real-time multi-user whiteboard collaboration, a description of the drawing/diagramming features, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
